summary: Subdivides line strips using per-strip, per-segment, distance, or curvature methods, then can optionally resample the result. It interpolates attributes and supports linear and spline interpolation methods.

key_params.name: divmethod
key_params.note: Division mode: none, per line strip, per segment, distance, or curvature

key_params.name: divs
key_params.note: Number of divisions

key_params.name: mindist
key_params.note: Minimum distance for curvature-based division

key_params.name: maxdist
key_params.note: Maximum distance between generated points

key_params.name: byedge
key_params.note: Restart distance division at each edge

key_params.name: addctrlpointattr
key_params.note: Outputs a ControlPoint attribute for original control points

key_params.name: maxverts
key_params.note: Preallocated maximum vertex count on the GPU

key_params.name: interpmethodpersegment
key_params.note: Read interpolation method from segment attributes

key_params.name: segmethodattr
key_params.note: Attribute containing per-segment interpolation method values

key_params.name: interpmethod
key_params.note: Interpolation mode such as linear, cardinal, B-spline, Bezier, or quadratic

key_params.name: useweight
key_params.note: Use a Weight attribute for spline interpolation

key_params.name: weightattr
key_params.note: Attribute supplying spline weights

key_params.name: usetanin
key_params.note: Use incoming tangent attributes for spline segments

key_params.name: taninattr
key_params.note: Attribute supplying incoming tangents

key_params.name: usetanout
key_params.note: Use outgoing tangent attributes for spline segments

key_params.name: tanoutattr
key_params.note: Attribute supplying outgoing tangents

key_params.name: usetaninconst
key_params.note: Use tangent constraint attributes

key_params.name: taninconstattr
key_params.note: Attribute supplying tangent constraints

key_params.name: clamped
key_params.note: Clamp cardinal interpolation at line ends

key_params.name: tension
key_params.note: Cardinal spline tension

key_params.name: resamplemethod
key_params.note: Optional post-divide resampling method

key_params.name: resampledivs
key_params.note: Division count for optional resampling

key_params.name: indvarattr
key_params.note: Independent variable attribute for keyframe-style resampling

key_params.name: indvarstep
key_params.note: Step size for independent-variable resampling

key_params.name: resamplemaxverts
key_params.note: Preallocated maximum vertex count for the resample stage

key_params.name: maxtries
key_params.note: Iteration limit used by adaptive resampling methods

key_params.name: rmvunusedpts
key_params.note: Remove points no longer referenced by output primitives

key_concepts: Division can be specified per line strip, per segment, by target distance, or adaptively from curvature.
Spline interpolation can consume Weight, TanIn, TanOut, tangent constraint, and segment method attributes when those controls are enabled.
The optional resampling stage is a second density-control pass, so both divide allocation and resample allocation must be sized for the generated vertices.
common_gotchas: maxverts must exceed the generated vertex count; undersizing truncates output because the GPU allocation is fixed.
Spline methods depend on attributes such as Weight, TanIn, TanOut, or segment method metadata when present.
Line Divide changes point density; follow with Line Metrics if later stages depend on distances, tangents, or strip indices.
